column6: Worked: hλ=-5; forward Euler factor -4 gives 1,-4,16,-64; backward Euler factor 1/6 gives 1,1/6,1/36. All correct.
Trapezoidal R(z)->-1 as z->-inf and backward Euler L-stability both correct.
Note only, not edited: Explainer and q0 explanation say RK4 needs h < 2/|λ| (that is the forward Euler bound; RK4's real-axis bound is about 2.79/|λ|). Same order of magnitude, so left alone.

Worked: GS ρ=0.25, ω_opt≈1.072, ρ=ω-1 above it, so 0.25/0.2/0.5/0.9 are correct. "A moderate ω beats GS" was vague because 1.5 could count as moderate yet loses (ρ=0.5). Named the ω values instead. Precision fix, not counted wrong.
Bullet 3 said ω changes "only how fast" the iterates converge. ω also decides whether SOR converges at all, which bullets 1-2 rely on. Dropped "only" and added convergence.

Worked: forward-difference error falls to about h≈2e-3, then rises like 2e-6/h, so the claim is correct. But "a rank-deficient system" is ambiguous: with inconsistent b it fails existence, not uniqueness. Changed to "a consistent rank-deficient system".
